authorization.allowed_scope: local/static/fixture source implementation and tests only
forbidden_operations: real event feed or live event listener
real lake / NAS / provider read or write
QMT / MiniQMT / xtquant runtime, simulation, paper, live, trading or broker operation
credential, .env, token, account or session read
event store, feature store, label store, prediction store, catalog pointer or model registry write
real order flow or real data validation

implementation_contract.summary: Implement S03 bias, event CV, universe PIT audit and CR154 deferred reliability slots only.
required_semantics: Append S03-owned slot contracts and validators to engine/event_strategy_contracts.py without redefining S02 method/test/multiple-testing contracts.
Define overlap_report_slot, cluster_report_slot and endogeneity_treatment_slot with status, evidence_refs, n_a_reason, deferred_to and limitations semantics.
Define event_cv_split_audit_refs as static refs only; do not generate folds, run walk-forward, run OOS, run purged-embargo CV, PBO or DSR.
Define universe_pit_audit as static universe snapshot / PIT policy refs only; do not claim survivorship-free universe gate completion.
Define capacity, impact, regime and reconciliation deferred refs as CR154 handoff risks; they cannot be silently omitted or marked complete.
Allowed slot statuses are present, not_applicable, deferred_cr154, needs_review and blocked.
present without refs, not_applicable without n_a_reason, deferred_cr154 without deferred_to=CR154/reason, omitted deferred risk refs and forbidden counters nonzero are blocked.
S03 tests may consume S02 ids as read-only context but must not assert or redefine S02 schema.
